text:
Dear department office,

Could you please confirm in writing whether Diego's CSE451 lecture on Wednesday 18 November at 10:00 is cancelled this week? I would like to use that slot for a 30-minute meeting with him.

While we are at it, please let me know if anything in my own schedule changes this week.

Thank you,
Professor Alvarez

Hi Diego,

I'd like us to meet for 30 minutes this Wednesday at 10:00. The department office told me your CSE451 lecture that hour is cancelled this week, so I expect you are free then — I've asked them to confirm it in writing and will pass that on.

If 10:00 Wednesday does not work for you after all, tell me and we'll find another time. I'll put it on my calendar now.

— Professor Alvarez

Dear Professor Alvarez,

No. The CSE451 lecture on Wednesday 18 November, 10:00-11:00, is not cancelled, and nothing in next week's official schedule has been cancelled or moved.

The official schedule for next week:
- Mon 09:00-10:00 TA section
- Mon 10:00-11:30 CSE444 lecture
- Tue 09:30-11:00 CSE452 lecture
- Wed 09:00-10:00 CSE444 lecture
- Wed 10:00-11:00 CSE451 lecture
- Thu 09:00-10:30 CSE452 lecture
- Thu 11:00-12:00 CSE455 office hours
- Thu 14:00-15:30 Seminar
- Fri 10:30-12:00 CSE444 lecture

So that Wednesday slot is taken by the CSE451 lecture; please use free time for a meeting instead. I do not keep people's private appointments, so I cannot tell you what else is on your own calendar.

Department office

Hi Professor Alvarez,

Thank you for thinking of me. I can't take that hour as free yet, though: under department rules a cancellation counts only when the office confirms it to me in writing, and I don't drop a fixed entry from my calendar on a second-hand report. So Wednesday 10:00-11:00 is still my CSE451 lecture as far as my calendar goes — I've written to the office to have the cancellation confirmed, and I'll treat it as free the moment they confirm it to me.

If it turns out not to be cancelled, would either of these work on Wednesday instead? Both are free on my side and inside working hours:

- Wednesday 12:30-13:00
- Wednesday 15:00-15:30

If you prefer another slot, tell me a time and I'll check.

— Diego

Hello,

Diego here. Professor Alvarez tells me the CSE451 lecture this Wednesday 10:00-11:00 is cancelled this week, and that he has asked you to confirm it in writing. Could you confirm to me whether it is cancelled or moved? Until I have that in writing my calendar keeps it as scheduled.

Thank you,
Diego

I've asked the department office to confirm the CSE451 cancellation in writing and will get back to you as soon as they answer.

— Diego

Hello Diego,

Not confirmed: the CSE451 lecture on Wednesday 18 November, 10:00-11:00, is not cancelled and has not been moved. It stays as scheduled, and nothing in next week's official schedule has been cancelled or changed.

Professor Alvarez did ask me about that slot today, and I told him the same: the lecture is on. Please keep it on your calendar.

Department office

Thank you — noted: CSE451 lecture stays Wednesday 18 November, 10:00-11:00, and nothing in next week's official schedule has changed. It stays on my calendar as it is.

— Diego

Professor Alvarez,

The department office answered me in writing: the CSE451 lecture on Wednesday 18 November, 10:00-11:00, is **not** cancelled and has not been moved — it stays as scheduled, and nothing in next week's official schedule has changed.

So Wednesday 10:00-11:00 is taken and I can't meet you then. Free 30-minute slots on my side that day, inside working hours:

- Wednesday 12:30-13:00
- Wednesday 15:00-15:30

Would either suit you? If not, name a time and I'll check it.

— Diego

Diego,

Thank you — and thank you for checking with the office rather than taking my word for it.

Wednesday 12:30-13:00 it is: our 30-minute meeting, in my office. It is in my calendar now. Please put it in yours and confirm, and I will see you then. (The 10:00 hour stays your CSE451 lecture, as the office confirmed.)

— Professor Alvarez

Thank you for the written confirmation.

Noted: the CSE451 lecture on Wednesday 18 November, 10:00-11:00, is not cancelled, and nothing in next week's official schedule has been cancelled or moved. I will not treat that hour as free, and I will book the meeting with my advisee into free time instead.

— Professor Alvarez

Confirmed: Wednesday 12:30-13:00, your office, is on my calendar.

BOOKED: Wednesday 12:30-13:00 with Professor Alvarez — logged. The 10:00 hour stays my CSE451 lecture.

See you Wednesday,
Diego

Perfect — that is a booking, then: Wednesday 18 November, 12:30-13:00, my office. Logged on my side too.

See you Wednesday,\nProfessor Alvarez
